book.name: Mwɛɛ mù Jiso gɛ̀ dunyɛ
book.title: Ŋwa wu mwɛɛ mù Jiso gɛ̀ dunyɛ Joŋ le

content: Ba toŋ soŋ chì kiŋgane kintɛh
Nchɛndaa wu Nyo wù kiŋgane kintɛh toŋ che soŋ, n'yɛŋ joŋ yimi le yì gɛ̀ ja fɛwe yi gwe fɛkuu. Ba nya kiŋgwenyɛ joŋ yiyu le kì gweenyi kintuge kì shiide nɛ ŋooŋŋ.
Joŋ yiyu mo yi gwenyɛ jwe wu kintuge kiyu, munjige bu yo nɛ gɛmm, njɛ mu bu fɛ mwɛɛ mù ba banyɛ ba kfuŋ le. Munjige mù gɛ̀ bude a kintuge kiyu le, mu ge juu bɛ kibvulɛ ja mu tu mu yiide lo.
Chúma bu a munjige muyu le yi shii yi nshɛŋ le. Bo nya chúma yiyu bɛ bvuŋga lɛ yi tâayi njɛ baŋgaŋ ba yi nshɛŋ le,
bo leh lɛ keefɛ yi chɛ̂ŋɛ bɛ mwɛɛ mù kuu yi nshɛŋ le gɛ, kɛnɛ nyume agaaŋ, kɛnɛ bite, kɛnɛ mo la la, bo duu lɛ yi nyâ ŋgɛ gɛh nyu kfuu chi bamii baa bò kɛme gɛ njiŋɛ wu Nyo fɛ bo jii gɛ.
Ba gɛ̀ chinɛ lɛ chúma yiyu nya ŋgɛ bamii le yi kii le yitɛŋ. Geenɛ lɛ keefɛ yi yûuyɛ lo bo gɛ. Ŋgɛ wù yi gɛ̀ bee ki yi nyâa gɛh bee njɛ wu ŋgaŋ sege wu le wu ta muh.
Yi kii yi yitɛŋ chinɛ le bamii lé bo gôone lo kwe bo yɛde gɛ. Bo lé bo bêede ki bo kwê, kwe lege lo bo.

Chúma chinɛ gɛ̀ bee njɛ nyámbala yì le yi seesɛ wa ki yi bû gwɛŋ wu jɛŋ le. Mwɛɛ mumu gɛ̀ bee a bo fwa njɛ bifo bi bvunfoŋ bì ba kɛnyi bɛ kichwa ki bige kì yɛɛde, manshi maboo nyume njɛ ma bamii.
Yvu yi bikwɛɛ biboo gɛ̀ bee njɛ yi bikɛse, bige biboo nyume njɛ bige bi bvule.
Yi gɛ̀ kɛme bibagɛ bi nyume njɛ kichwa ki bamii ba jɛŋ kì ba baŋe gvúu yu. Yi doo yi fuune bibɛɛ biboo tu bi yode njɛ bakoto ba duude bo chiide nyámbala sege yi lege gwɛŋ wu jɛŋ le.
Yi kɛme chiŋgvunyi bɛ gɛŋ njɛ baŋgaŋ. Bvuŋga bvuboo bvu bo gɛ̀ nyaa ŋgɛ yu bamii le yi kii le yitɛŋ nyu yi chiŋgvunyi chinɛ le.

Bo gɛ̀ kɛme nfoŋ wuboo nyume nchɛndaa wù jiiŋe fɛ kintuge kì shiide nɛ ŋooŋŋ kɛɛ le, jee che nyume a jɛ́ yi Ibulu le lɛ Abadoŋ, chi nyume a jɛ́ yi Glek le lɛ, Abolioŋ (Jee chinɛ nyume lɛ muh wù chɛŋe lo).
Wunɛ ŋgɛ wù fe baaŋ gɛh lo wù fwe. Geenɛ bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, bamu baŋgɛ baaŋ bo bii ajiŋ bafɛɛ.
Bo toŋ soŋ chì kiŋgane kinsoo
Nchɛndaa wu Nyo wù kiŋgane kinsoo toŋ che soŋ, n'yu jɛ bu fɛ binchoo bì binɛh bì le bi kitana ki kintanyɛ ki ba kɛ̂nyi bɛ kichwa ki bige kì yɛɛde, ki nyu a Nyo fwe,
yi jɛmɛ nchɛndaa wu Nyo wù kiŋgane kinsoo wu gɛ̀ kɛme soŋ wɛɛ le lɛ, “Fâanyɛ banchɛndaa ba banɛh ba bo le bo kaaŋ mbebe yi joo yì kuge yì Yuflɛti le.”

Noo, Nchɛndaa wu Nyo wuyu mo wu faanyɛ banchɛndaa ba banɛh bayu. Banchɛndaa bayu nyu ba gɛ̀ seesɛ ba gɛɛ bo chiɛɛne kife bɛ juu mo kwii bɛ kiluŋ kì ba lé ba gê ba fâanyɛ bo, ba yûuyɛ kimbe kimimia antɛnɛɛ a bitɛde bi bamii.
Ŋgɛ̀ yu no ŋgoo yi bamii ba jɛŋ ba yi nyámbala le gɛ̀ bee. Bo gɛ̀ bee bamala gii yifɛɛ (200,000,000).

Nyámbala yì ŋgɛ̀ yɛŋ a fiɛɛ fì le njɛ kifilɛ fiɛɛ, mo bamii ba gɛ̀ bɛɛne yi le gɛ̀ bee a yinɛ je le: Bamii bayu gɛ̀ bee bo jii bichwa bo baŋe gvúu yu, nchoŋ yiyu yɛɛle njɛ ŋgu, yi ka nyume njɛ kibvulɛ, fi ka nyume tɛ njɛ fi yɛɛde. Bikwɛɛ bi nyámbala biyu gɛ̀ fiɛɛnɛ bi babvule, ŋgu bɛ munjige mo fiɛɛ fimi njɛ muŋkaŋ mù bɛɛde, mu bude a yi mu.
Mwɛɛ mu baŋgɛ munɛ mù gɛ̀ bee, ŋgu bɛ munjige mo fiɛɛ njɛ muŋkaŋ mù bɛɛdɛ, mù gɛ̀ bude a nyámbala yiyu mu gɛ̀ bee mu yuuyɛ bamii kimbe kimimia antɛnɛɛ a bitɛde.
Bvuŋga bvu nyámbala yiyu gɛ̀ bee a yi mu bɛ chiŋgvunyi chiboo le. Chiŋgvunyi chiboo nyume njɛ yó yi kɛme bikwɛɛ, nyume fiɛɛ fì yi lɛŋse bamii yu.

Mo no fi gɛ̀ kooshɛ noo, kimbɛge ki bamii mo mwɛɛ mù baŋgɛ munɛ gɛ̀ baaŋ yuuyɛ gɛ bo gɛ, bo gɛ̀ baaŋ mo kusɛ gɛ muntele muboo yi mwɛɛ mù bo gɛ̀ gee bɛ chiaaŋ yiboo le gɛ. Bo gɛ̀ baaŋ kusɛ gɛ ki bo bûune banchɛndaa ba debele bɛ mumooso kɛnɛ nyume mù ba kɛnyi bɛ kichwa ki bige kì yɛɛde, kɛnɛ kì baaŋ, kɛnɛ bɛ kichu kì nɛɛ, kɛnɛ ata, kɛnɛ kite. Mumooso munɛ nyume njɛ taŋlo mu yɛŋ fiɛɛ le sɛŋ, kɛnɛ mu yu sɛŋ, kɛnɛ mu jiɛnyɛ sɛŋ.
Bo gɛ̀ baaŋ mo kusɛ gɛ tɛ muntele ki bo yûuyi bamii kɛnɛ ki bo gêe nfiŋ, kɛnɛ ki bo chêe kinche ki nyiɛŋ yi kinjaŋ, kɛnɛ ki bo chôŋe gɛ.
